title: Features by business

CASH_POS.name: Cash register / POS
CASH_POS.description: Registers, shifts, cash movements, counts and POS sales.

COUNTER_SALE.name: Counter sales
COUNTER_SALE.description: Orders created, paid and handed over in a single step at the branch.

AI_PAYMENT_VERIFICATION.name: AI receipt verification
AI_PAYMENT_VERIFICATION.description: Analyzes the transfer receipts customers send and scores the risk.

AI_PRODUCT_IMPORT.name: AI product import
AI_PRODUCT_IMPORT.description: Import products from CSV, images or PDF with automatic classification.

BOT_VOICE.name: Assistant voice
BOT_VOICE.description: Formality, emojis and the assistant's name. Also requires the Pro or Enterprise plan.

DINE_IN_QR.name: Table orders + QR
DINE_IN_QR.description: Tables with printable QR codes and ordering from the table.

OPERATOR_CATALOG_ORDER.name: Take orders from the catalog
OPERATOR_CATALOG_ORDER.description: Staff open the web catalog with a session and take orders (for example, for tables).

TIPS.name: Tips
TIPS.description: Optional tip on table and counter orders.

GLOBAL_CATALOG.name: Global catalog
GLOBAL_CATALOG.description: Industry product library that the business can add to its catalog.

AI_BOT_PARAPHRASE.name: Bot message paraphrasing
AI_BOT_PARAPHRASE.description: AI rewrites the assistant's messages so they sound more natural.

BOT_MESSAGES.name: Editable assistant messages
BOT_MESSAGES.description: The business edits the assistant's messages by hand or with AI. Also requires the Pro or Enterprise plan.
